mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect fair conditions with temperatures holding steady at 70 degrees near Badger Prairie County Park.
In city news, the Plan Commission is set to review the Liberty Business Park project on December 7th, while Municipal Court continues to process traffic and ordinance citations.
There is plenty to do this week, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and continuing tomorrow with the Dane County Farmers' Market and performances at Paddy Mac's.
On October 19th, the Verona Police Department took a 49-year-old man into custody for operating with a suspended license and an active arrest warrant.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM, so stop by and grab a scoop.
